feature: least-request child policy inside SharedChannel weighted_target

scope.completion: unary and streaming success/error terminal paths

contracts: weighted_target delegates one selected READY child picker
least-request samples choiceCount READY endpoints with replacement
the count includes claimed work before stream materialization and returns at terminal completion

implementation.subset: least-request sees only workers under the child node hierarchical prefix
implementation.sampling: power-of-N samples READY workers with available HTTP2 stream capacity
implementation.comparison: the sampled worker with the smallest child-local outstanding count wins
implementation.claim: outstanding increments only after the selected worker claims the queued job
implementation.completion: State.finishOutstandingLocked delegates real workers to the weighted runtime and decrements on unary and streaming terminal paths
implementation.isolation: sibling weighted targets do not contribute workers or counters
implementation.test_seam: comptime worker-type guarding preserves minimal stream terminal-deadline test doubles

native_case.configuration: one weight-1 target with least_request choiceCount 10
assertions: fast endpoint receives more than twice the slow endpoint traffic
every worker outstanding counter returns to zero

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC SharedChannel weighted target least request' --summary all
remaining_gap: ring-hash, weighted-round-robin, outlier children, membership churn, and ordinary Channel remain before broad weighted_target completion
